serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Annalie: Hello you two.
You: Hi, did you wait long for us?
#bot.Expression.happy
#Annalie_Outside.face.pervy
Annalie: A few minutes at most. I left shop early, you two got me this excited~
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Bot: You look great Annalie!
You: Yeah, I think that’s the first time I see you outside your shop. It suits you.
Annalie: Thanks~
Annalie: Sit down you two and let’s order something.
You: Damn, this menu is huge. I have no idea what to take.
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: Me too…
#bot.Expression.shock
Bot: Who needs over fifty different types of coffee?
#bot.Expression.clear
Annalie: Hey, don’t be too harsh, you two. It’s still a cafe owned by my friends.
#Annalie_Outside.Arm.up
Annalie: There are 58 different types of coffees because my friends have many different blends from all sorts of countries.
Annalie: Even now, they go around the world looking for new flavours. That’s why this whole place is automated.
#Annalie_Outside.Arm.down
You: I thought that it’s automated, cuz employees are expensive.
Annalie: Well, there’s that too.
Annalie: Although I’m a fan of actually meeting my clients. Owning an online shop is no fun at all!
#Annalie_Outside.face.pervy
Annalie: What’s the point of selling cute clothes to a cute girl if I can’t even see her wearing them!
You: I don’t think seeing cute girls is a merchant's main objective…
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww
Annalie: What? Got something against it?
You: Not at all, you do you. 
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
You: Coming to you to do the shopping is always a pleasure, I'm sure you know it.
Annalie: Ha! You don’t need to suck up to me so hard, you already have a girlfriend sweetie, I don’t like crowds.
Annalie: Listen, if you don’t know what to choose, take something lite at first with some sweet cake like tart or shortcake.
Bot: Got it.
You: So we put our order on this tablet and then what?
Annalie: When it’s ready, your number will flash on one of these boards. You just need to get up and take it.
You: Like fast food.
Annalie: Kinda kills for me that whole concept of this high-end cafe to be honest, but oh well.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Annalie: Don’t tell my friends I said something like that if you ever meet them, they wouldn’t be happy about it…
You: They must be quite rich to own a place like this.
Annalie: They are and yet, they never gave me a discount coupon.
Annalie: But enough about them, I’m more interested in you two~
You: Oh, our orders are ready, I will go pick them up.
Annalie: What a gentleman, you must be quite happy with him {f_botName}.
#bot.Expression.blush
Bot: I am…
